frequency_question: How often do structural frictions successfully prevent or delay threatened protectionist tariffs beyond the implementation deadline?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly threatened broad tariffs requiring formal implementation mechanisms; excludes minor targeted anti-dumping duties or purely rhetorical threats never advanced to administrative processing.
provenance_note: claimed 2 hits but 1 of 6 cases are marked hit; rate recomputed from the cases
coverage_note: 6 major historical instances identified where broad executive tariff threats faced structural or negotiated friction.
known_gaps: Historical variance across different statutory authorities (IEEPA vs Section 232/301).
skeleton: Threatened broad tariffs subject to rapid administrative execution vs. those halted by structural/negotiated friction before deadline.
multiplier: 2 halts out of 6 major historical threat episodes
validity_reason: Executive trade authorities and institutional friction points remain relatively stable under current trade statutes.
